click_screen_coordinates: click the screen at physical coordinates x, y with a mouse click action
press_keyboard_shortcut: press a keyboard shortcut like ctrl+v or alt+f4 using virtual key codes
find_block_on_screen: find a UI block template image on screen and return center position and match confidence
grab_window_screenshot: grab a DPI-safe PIL Image screenshot of a window by its hwnd
move_cursor_to_position: move the mouse cursor to a logical coordinate position with DPI scaling applied
